lines.en: I’ve been feeling a little better ever since Wakana showed up at my house to not give me a blowjob.
And while I’m sure I could multiply that feeling tenfold by visiting everyone else who cares about me and hasn’t moved out, I’ve elected to just wander around town this morning instead.
So today, it’s less I’m wallowing in my hopelessness and more like I’m going on a leisurely stroll with it — where the two of us will awkwardly attempt to get to know each other a little better.
As it turns out, my shadow has also had three great loves and managed to squander each of them.
He’s not as perturbed by the heat, though. And he doesn’t mind the unpredictable weather patterns ushered in by whatever season we’re in.
I think it’s spring, but I forget sometimes. So I ask him and he tells me I’m correct.
He can read my thoughts, but I can’t read his. And I find that unfair because he is a parasitic being who can’t detach himself and live without me.

Regardless, our spontaneous bout of camaraderie proceeds as I do one more lap around the block and tell myself it is the last. That I don’t care to learn more about hopelessness when I’m already so familiar with it.
This mistake has been mostly harmless, though. And by “harmless” I mean that, in the event of suffering, it can only happen to me or the shadow.
And by “me or the shadow” I just mean me. Because no matter how many times I step on him, he does not cry out.
How annoying it is for my unwanted offspring to be the one impervious to pain while I ascend these stairs with a mental limp.
It’s just then that my phone rings, though. And of course I answer it because, despite how desperately I wish to be alone, I just can’t bring myself to be alone.
The shadow laughs and peels itself off of me, leaving me forever as I swallow its name and tap on a piece of glass.
: Hello?
: Good morning, Sensei. You’re not busy right now, are you?
: Does being sad count as being busy?
: I hope not as my schedule would be packed for the rest of eternity if that were the case.
: Want to come over and have another marathon of sex? I have the house all to myself because everyone hates me now.
: As fun as that sounds, and it does sound very fun, I was actually wondering if you’d want to get coffee instead. On me, of course.
: Why would I want to get coffee on you? That sounds like a lawsuit waiting to happen and I know that you’re an attorney now.
: Okay. Allow me to rephrase that then if you’re going to be difficult today. Can I put on a dress and buy you coffee? I feel like we’ve been under-utilizing the infinite amount of time we have here.
: Can I take the dress off afterwards?
: Oh, you’re wearing one too?
: Makoto, if we are so sad, why are we both so funny? It shouldn’t work that way.
: But it does. And I’m just going to assume that you’re accepting my invitation because you haven’t said no.
: Now you’re speaking my language — dubious consent.
: I’ll keep that in mind when I get to take your dress off later.
Makoto hangs up the phone and sends me a text telling me to meet her at the park near the school.
I send one back saying I need to head back home and get changed first.
Of course it’s a lie, though. I’m good at that. Here’s another. Watch.
: I definitely don’t want to fuck you right now.
: If you tell yourself that enough, it might actually come true one day.
: Okay, maybe I’m not as good at lying as I thought.
: Oh, I didn’t realize you were going to be practicing today. That’s fine, though. I’m happy so long as we’re together.
: You’re being very cute today. What’s the catch?
: There is no catch. Also, I’m practicing lying as well.
: Okay, so what’s the catch then?
: Walk with me. I’ll tell you on the way.
: So — I wanted to get your feelings on how you want to handle all of this reset stuff since Ayane wants me to start taking more initiative or something.
: I see. And I assume that you still just don’t really care?
: Pretty much, yeah. And since Yumi’s also in the loop as well, no pun intended, I figure we finally have enough people to start forming factions.
: Is this you trying to enlist me?
: Only if it’s working.
: I can’t do that to Ayane. She wants to grow up and have babies and all of that boring stuff.
: Also, I think I’d actually be able to follow through with castrating myself if I accidentally reset someone through sex again. So I’d like to avoid that, if possible.
: Staying abstinent until we figure out the secrets of the universe then?
: Depends on whether or not I’m on the roof of the school.
: Darn. There goes my next fantasy.
: But anyway, since I can’t win you over, which I didn’t really plan on doing in the first place, I figure we should start plotting out our next move.
: The beach trip’s coming up soon. Think another slumber party is in the cards? Or should we try something a little different?
: Didn’t we only do that because we thought a reset was looming?
: That was part of it, I think. But I’m pretty sure Ayane’s main goal was just figuring out who could retain information and who couldn’t.
: It was a fine plan, I think. Or I guess more of a fine idea than anything else. But we left out a key component for...emotional purposes that I believe we need to start reincorporating.
: You want to bring Maya back into the picture...
: She doesn’t change the topic when it comes up. She’s been through this before. But more important than all of that, she could sense when a reset was coming.
: I figured that was more due to experience than some sort of sixth sense, though.
: Could’ve been. Or she could be special. Because, based on what I’ve seen, she’s changed more dramatically than anyone else. And that makes her an outlier.
: The only problem is that you and Ayane have some sort of pseudo-PTSD from her past involvement in all of this.
: But if you really want to get out of the loops, that needs to be overcome. And the sooner we get her back to the apocalypse, the better.
: Sure. But the real question is how we get her up to the roof in the first place — which is a thing we can’t even figure out for ourselves.
: What if it doesn’t need to be the roof, though?
: What?
: Think about it — why would a singular rooftop make any sort of difference in a timeloop? Is there any specific reason we go there?
: Or are we just following the footsteps laid by someone who ultimately and tragically failed?
: You’re proposing that we just...sit through the next one then? Risk our memories just to see what happens?
: Well, let me ask you this — how attached are you to the current Maya?
: Because I need to know how sad you’ll be if she winds up getting reset again.
: Are you trying to...sacrifice her, Makoto?
: Not exactly. I’m just willing to risk it.
: If we can get Maya to come back into the picture and leave her somewhere outside of the rooftop during a reset...if she makes it through, it changes everything.
: And if she doesn’t, nothing of value is lost. We just get a new one.
: Of course, this is only if you guys are willing, though. Since you’re the ones who might be upset if it doesn’t work out.
: That’s...
: I don’t know, Makoto...I think we can come up with something better.
: If you can, feel free. I’m just throwing out ideas. And I don’t blame you at all for falling for her all over again if that’s why you’re hesitating. She is your Juliet after all.
: Have you brought this up to Ayane yet?
: I wanted to test it on you first. Mostly just to see if I could convince you to give up entirely, though.
: Yeah...
: I think there might be a better chance of that, to be honest...
: Hey, Sensei! Hey, Makoto! I’m not jealous at all right now!
: You don’t mind that we came here on our date...do you, Rin?
: Nope! Like I said, not jealous at all! Just your average barista working her average job, totally single and totally not crushing on your man!
: Oh, so you’re just open about it now then.
: I go on break in thirty minutes. How about a double date? I get you and Makoto can have Haruka.
: I think that’d make Haruka happy at least.
: You can take Haruka, Rin. You’re the one here who likes girls. I’ll keep my original date.
: Okay, new plan. He gets Haruka and then you and I date. That way, we both lose and everything is fair again.
: Doesn’t Haruka win if we do that?
: Okay! Final suggestion! You go sit on the right side of the cafe and us three girls will hang out over on the left. Are we in agreement?
: Can you just take my money please? Two coffees.
: Who’s the second one for? Me or Haruka?
: Sensei.
: That’s not what we agreed on.
: We never agreed on anything! Just take my money and stop trying to steal my date!
: You guys are gonna have sex after this, aren’t you?
: Maybe!
: Hah...
: Two coffees...that’ll be one million yen.
: No it won’t! Charge us the normal price!
: Sorry about that. Rin is apparently aggressively pursuing me now to make up for lost time.
: To be honest, I’m surprised it’s taken her this long. Have the two of you even kissed yet?
: Yeah. That’s it, though.
: Really? So am I the special one then for having you take my virginity, like...years before we kissed?
: You’re special in a lot of ways, Makoto. That’s just one of them. Sidenote — do you still have that witch costume?
: I’m going to say no just because I’m acutely aware that you will immediately finish your coffee and drag me out of here for sexual purposes when I still have more things to talk about.
: Ugh. But we’ve already talked so much today and you’re so cute.
: Well, on the bright side, I want to talk about sex this time. How’s that for a compromise?
: Oh, fun. What’s up? Hit me.
: Did you tell my mom we’re fucking each other’s brains out?
: Ugh. And here I was expecting this conversation to be enjoyable.
: Did you tell her or not?
: No, Makoto. I did not tell your mom that we are having any amount of sex.
: I just clued her in on my sexual background and provided a perfect opportunity for her skepticism about what I do with you in private to blossom.
: Well, thank you for that. Because I am now being “talked to” on a regular basis and reminded to always be extremely careful when it comes to who I do things with.
: Sounds like good news to me. Your mom is being a mom. Now, you can’t complain about her not being a mom anymore.
: It’s more just annoying than anything. And I kind of figured you didn’t since you’re not that self-destructive...But it got me thinking. What if you did?
: Uhhhh...
: No?
: Or what if I did?
: Why would you? Is there something you’re not telling me about yourself?
: I’m just still trying to figure out what sort of information sticks and what doesn’t.
: People have their memories purged to a certain extent after the resets, don’t they?
: Yes, but only regarding information directly relevant to the resets I think. Which is why people like Tsuneyo can catch on and then just...forget.
: But there isn’t really, like...a rule-book that tells us what stays and what doesn’t. So I have no idea, really.
: So theoretically, if she caught us having sex while we were discussing resets and the like, would she forget the entire event? Or would she remember the sex but not the timey-wimey stuff?
: First, you want to sacrifice Maya. Now, you want to orchestrate a weird sexual event that ends with your mom finding out I’m a predator? This universe has broken you, Makoto.
: I’m not trying to orchestrate anything. I’m just trying to figure out how much of a sandbox this world really is.
: My mom knowing about us becomes a much smaller problem if she just stops knowing after a certain amount of time, right?
: I guess? But what’s the benefit to her finding out at all?
: Well, I imagine the lectures would stop if she knew it was too late to keep me from you. All of her yapping is ruining my infinite vacation.
: Lucky. Mine keeps being ruined by me losing the people I love.
: I’m still here, aren’t I? Unless you’ve just been lying about loving me this whole time.
: Of course I love you, Makoto. I just don’t love you enough to have sex with you in front of your mom.
: Can you really call that “love” at all then? Plus, I think it’d be a good way to get back at her for all the times I heard her and my dad and whoever else going at it in their bedroom.
: Let’s maybe let Miku catch us first before we start bringing your only remaining family back into the picture.
: I’m just saying, if we can get a definitive answer about what sort of information carries over from cycle to cycle, we can start pushing people a little harder.
: Which accomplishes what, though? That’s the part I’m not getting.
: Again — testing the sandbox.
: Maybe we just haven’t gotten anywhere because we haven’t been trying hard enough? And maybe there’s something so terrible that doing it would force a reset?
: I don’t-
: I had a dream recently, Sensei. That this world was alive and we were its entertainment. Little ants rummaging through a thin, plastic rectangle in the room of some god or something.
: Now, if you had an ant farm, and the ants built their little tunnel and just started living normal, peaceful lives...you’d get bored of them pretty quickly, right?
: But you could make them dig all over again if you just picked up the ant farm and shook it.
: Maybe that’s what resets are? Maybe we’ve made our tunnel and are just going about our days now like they don’t matter at all.
: So you...what? Want to build a second tunnel? Add a little annex or something?
: Not at all. I want to stay here. I like living on the farm.
: I just know a few ants who don’t. And there’s plenty of sand lying around that we could build a bridge or a staircase with if we all worked together.
: It’d mean acting...differently, though. Deviating from what’s expected from us so there’s never a reason to shake up our home at all.
: But of course, there are plenty of risks associated with that as well. And there’d be nothing stopping our make-believe god from spreading borax all over the floor.
: It really just comes down to if you want to take that risk or not.
: Or if you’d be happier just...lying in the sand with me. And everyone else who doesn’t need to know what happens on the outside.
: This is a...rather chaotic side of you, Makoto.
: Blame Ayane. She’s the one who told me I needed to try a little harder.
: Yeah, well...
: I think you might be trying a little too hard. And I don’t think Ayane will blame you if you tone it down a bit.
: Okay...if that’s what you wish, Sensei.
: Let me say this, though...if any of that really seemed like too much to you?...
: You might be better off joining my faction after all.
Makoto and I finish our coffee and return to my house to have copious amounts of sex.
Before I know it, she is asleep in my bed with her clothes left somewhere near the door.
I slide under the blanket beneath her and close my eyes to try and get some rest.
But every once in a while, it feels like there’s something crawling on my leg.
Makoto’s affection has increased to [makoto_love]!
Makoto’s lust has increased to [makoto_lust]!
